questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to handle partition DP with subarray distinct value counting; combines precomputation optimization with reconstruction techniques not covered in standard partition problems.

## Key Concepts
- Partition DP with subarray metrics
- Precompute distinct counts (O(n²))
- Reconstruction via parent pointers

## Code Example
```python
def max_distinct_partition(A, k):
    n = len(A)
    # Precompute distinct counts
    dist = [[0]*(n+2) for _ in range(n+2)]
    for l in range(1, n+1):
        freq = {}
        seen = 0
        for r in range(l, n+1):
            x = A[r-1]
            if x not in freq:
                freq[x] = 1
                seen += 1
            dist[l][r] = seen
    
    # DP with parent tracking
    dp = [[-float('inf')]*(k+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    parent = [[-1]*(k+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    
    # Base cases
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        dp[i][1] = dist[1][i]
    
    # Fill DP
    for t in range(2, k+1):
        for i in range(t, n+1):
            for p in range(t-1, i):
                val = dp[p][t-1] + dist[p+1][i]
                if val > dp[i][t]:
                    dp[i][t] = val
                    parent[i][t] = p
    
    # Reconstruct partitions
    partitions = []
    i, t = n, k
    while t > 1:
        p = parent[i][t]
        partitions.append(p)
        i, t = p, t-1
    partitions.reverse()
    
    return dp[n][k], partitions
```

## Time/Space Complexity
Time: O(n² + n²k) = O(n²k) - O(n²) for precomputation, O(n²k) for DP
Space: O(n² + nk) - O(n²) for distinct counts, O(nk) for DP and parent pointers

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to structure a DP solution for scheduling with deadlines and selection limits, including schedule reconstruction.

## Key Concepts
- Weighted interval scheduling with job count constraint
- DP with backtracking for schedule reconstruction
- Time/space optimization and tie handling

## Code Example
```python
# DP[i][j]: max profit using first i jobs with j chosen
# p(i): rightmost index < i compatible with job i
for i in 1..n:
  for j in 1..K:
    DP[i][j] = max(DP[i-1][j], DP[p(i)][j-1] + profit[i])
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you optimize to O(n K) space?
